messages:
Priya (AE): Heads-up — NovaSys wants a bundled package: API + Optimize + Console. They're pushing for 40% off list and a 18-month commit. Asking for BYOK, SOC2 attestation, and a capped overage for month-to-month spikes. Closing window: end of this month.

Tom (SE): POC summary: API steady at ~500k tokens/mo with spikes to 1.2M. Optimize runs ~15k jobs/mo. Console heavy for ops during onboarding. No data residency requirement but they insist on BYOK for keys.

Rina (Deal Desk): 40% is outside policy. Typical max on bundles is 30% with 1.5x-2.0x commit. Overage cap requests need RevOps signoff. Can you send estimated ARR and proposed cap?

Priya (AE): Rate card and ask below:
```
List prices (ann):
- API: $0.0009/token -> est $160k/yr
- Optimize: $60k/yr
- Console: $40k/yr
List total: $260k/yr
Customer asks: 40% -> $156k/yr, 18mo commit (~$234k total).
Requested cap: monthly overage capped at +25% of committed spend.
Requested security: BYOK and SOC2 report upload prior to go-live.
```

Oscar (Eng-Security): SOC2 report is fine to provide. Hosted BYOK is not supported currently for standard tenants. We can offer Dedicated or a Contractual KMS escrow solution. Dedicated lead time ~6 weeks. KMS escrow needs Legal to approve language.

Hannah (Product): Console retention default is 180 days. We can offer 90 days as a concession for the bundle. Important: caps on token throttling can affect latency. Need to confirm acceptable throttling behavior.

Eli (Legal): I can draft a KMS escrow clause and an overage cap addendum. Escrow introduces complexity — need to define key rotation, access, and termination behavior. Also confirm if they need deletion SLA shorter than our standard 30 days.

Rina (Deal Desk): Suggested counter: 30% discount + 18mo commit (1.5x) OR 35% with 2.0x commit. Overage cap allowed at +15% w/ exception. Anything beyond that needs CRO approval. Also need CRO for any SOC2+BYOK commercial concession.

Priya (AE): Customer wants 40% but might accept 35% if we include a 1-year free Professional Services onboarding and the overage cap at +20%. Will confirm exec appetite for co-sell / joint PR.

Tom (SE): Technical note: if we go Dedicated to satisfy BYOK, Ops will need an install window. We should add a 6-8 week delivery SLA to the SOW. Also flag that dedicated infra costs may require a baseline infra charge.

Mark (CRO): I'm looped. 35% requires 2.0x commit and RevOps check. 40% needs C-level approval + legal signoff on KMS escrow. Send me the final ARR figures and attach the POC performance summary; I'll review for exception.

Priya (AE): Filling exception form now: final ask I'm submitting is 35% discount, 18mo commit (2.0x), overage cap +20% (but accept +15% if Legal demands), Dedicated for BYOK with 6-8 week delivery SLA, SOC2 report, and 90-day console retention. Attaching POC artifacts.

Eli (Legal): Once I get the file, I'll draft the KMS escrow terms and overage cap language. Need to know whether we charge a dedicated infra setup fee.

Rina (Deal Desk): I'll route this to RevOps + CRO. If Mark approves, I'll process the discount exception. Keep any co-marketing commitments measured — we need written scope.

Priya (AE): Thanks — will ping once NovaSys confirms acceptance of the 35% + PS onboarding.

Tom (SE): Note for posterity: verify token accounting method (input vs output tokens) before finalizing billing to avoid disputes.
